blocks.text: Sri Lanka’s Asian Games 2026 medal prospect Rumesh Tharanga Pathirage returned home after winning the title at a top international event on Tuesday to find his prized javelins in pieces. The 23-year-old rising star, who has taken the javelin world by storm this year with a series of impressive victories, was heartbroken to discover that his javelins had snapped. “This was a rude shock,” Pathirage’s coach, Tony Prasanna, told AFP. “We checked in five javelins — all packed extremely carefully and well — but all of them arrived broken.” Pathirage posted a photograph of his damaged javelins on social media, listing […]...
